title: Google bets on superhot geothermal to power Oregon data centers

meta.summary: The geothermal startup  Quaise Energy has landed a major first customer for its novel, superhot project in central Oregon. On Tuesday, the Houston-based firm announced that  Google has agreed to buy 50 megawatts of carbon-free power from Quaise’s first commercial project, called Project Obsidian, near the Newberry…
